traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Known for its large, semi-circular to fan-shaped fruit bodies that can grow up to 20 cm wide and 5 cm thick. The cap surface is velvety and typically white to pale cream, sometimes turning brownish with age. It has a poroid hymenium with white pores and a white spore print.
